== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-joe-horbey-ls-luke-saga/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Horbey LS Luke Saga.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114030440/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-joe-horbey-ls-luke-saga.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>57d023874f140e9daa1f4664371bac12964598427feeb1f22117cb76c31eac0b</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[I Don't Like Sand (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>200_39^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
* 1x [[Tydirium (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>218_31^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
